steps.title: record cliport evidence · cliport pick place action
steps.code:
ev_box = res_box.output["evidence_id"]
ev_unicorn = res_unicorn.output["evidence_id"]

unicorn_pos = res_unicorn.output["instance"]["pose0"][0]
box_pos = res_box.output["instance"]["pose0"][0]
box_quat = res_box.output["instance"]["pose0"][1]

pick_pose = [
    [unicorn_pos[0], unicorn_pos[1], unicorn_pos[2]],
    [0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0],
]
place_pose = [[box_pos[0], box_pos[1], 0.05], box_quat]

primitives.call(
    name="record_cliport_evidence",
    key="grounding",
    value={
        "source_object_id": 6,
        "target_object_id": 5,
        "evidence_ids": [ev_unicorn, ev_box],
        "pick_pose": pick_pose,
        "place_pose": place_pose,
    },
)

res_act = primitives.call(
    name="submit_cliport_pick_place_action",
    evidence_ids=[ev_unicorn, ev_box],
    pick_pose=pick_pose,
    place_pose=place_pose,
    source_object_id=6,
    target_object_id=5,
    query="pack the unicorn toy in the brown box",
)
print("Action result:", res_act.output if res_act.ok else res_act)
